title: MCP tools in Genie Agents are generally available
body: MCP tools in Genie Agents are now generally available. Authors can attach external MCP servers registered in Unity Gateway, in addition to Databricks-provided connectors, and the Agent mode APIs support MCP tools. See [Connect a Genie Agent to MCP tools and sources](/aws/en/genie-agents/external-tools).
